state_update_interval.label: State Update Interval
state_update_interval.description: Seconds between automatic device state refreshes. 0 disables auto-refresh.

enable_charging_animation.label: Show Charging Fill
enable_charging_animation.description: Highlight the bar widget when the device is charging.

custom_image.label: Device Image
custom_image.description: Set a custom image for the selected device. Leave empty for default icon.

device_alias.label: Device Alias
device_alias.description: Custom display name for the selected device.

enable_clipboard_action.label: Show Clipboard Action
enable_clipboard_action.description: Show a quick action to send the clipboard to the device.

show_ongoing_media.label: Show Ongoing Media
show_ongoing_media.description: Show media currently playing on the phone.

show_device_placeholder.label: Show Device Placeholder
show_device_placeholder.description: Show the device graphic in the details panel.

scan_subdirectories.label: Scan Subdirectories
scan_subdirectories.description: Recursively scan subdirectories of the recent images path.

max_recent_images.label: Max Recent Images
max_recent_images.description: Number of recent images to display.

panel_placement.label: Panel Placement
panel_placement.description: How the details panel opens: attached to the bar, or floating.

panel.title: Phone Connect
panel.empty: No devices found. Pair a device in KDE Connect.
